data.name: Sentinel Grid
data.description: Tri-signal early-warning system for population and workforce health in the UAE. Fuses clinical, environmental and occupational signals (Prophet baselines, PyOD anomaly ensemble, Bayesian fusion with 90% CIs). Every alert is explained with TreeSHAP drivers and a validated LLM narrative in English and Arabic, then routed via n8n to the public-health role who must act. Backtested on 11 real 2023–24 UAE events: alerts land in real event windows up to 4.7× more often than chance.

data.name: HeartGuard AI
data.description: Clinical decision-support tool on the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Hard/soft voting ensembles with leakage-safe preprocessing and nested stratified 5-fold CV; threshold chosen to keep sensitivity ≥ 0.90. Sensitivity 0.902 · Specificity 0.797 · ROC AUC 0.908. Served via FastAPI + a clinician-facing React UI, with a model card and Dockerized backend.

data.name: SupplyChainOS
data.description: Governed natural-language analytics agent on a Snowflake Semantic View + Cortex Agent. Raised strict accuracy from 40% to 90% on a 30-question gold set by analysing every failure — the same evaluation discipline I apply to clinical models.

data.name: Diffusion Image Editing (MDP)
data.description: Implemented all four algorithms from the MDP research paper (the reference repo covered one) for text-guided image editing with Stable Diffusion, with Gradio apps for real and synthetic images.

data.name: Multi-Agent Content Creator
data.description: Four cooperating LangGraph agents (strategy, writer, SEO, reviewer) on Llama 3.1 via Groq, with a quality-control loop that sends drafts back for revision.

data.name: TravelStack
data.description: Multi-source ETL with rule-based validation that flagged 32% of raw records for quality issues, exposed over a FastAPI service and orchestrated with Airflow — the kind of data cleaning messy health records need too.
